# Why Linux Is Different

URL: __BASE__start/why-linux/

> A fixture page about Linux contracts.

Linux is not a product with a vendor. The [Flatpak & Portals](__BASE__platform/flatpak-portals/) page explains sandboxing.

## The four contracts

Linux desktops share display, packaging, integration, and quality contracts.

# Flatpak & Portals

URL: __BASE__platform/flatpak-portals/

> A fixture page about Flatpak, portals, and sandboxing.

Flatpak runs the app in a sandbox. [Why Linux Is Different](__BASE__start/why-linux/) explains the ecosystem.

## Portals you will use

File chooser, notifications, and screen capture go through portals.
